basics.name: Omar Boza
basics.label: Frontend / Full-Stack Developer | React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, PostgreSQL
basics.summary: Frontend-focused full-stack developer with professional experience shipping production web apps in modern JavaScript/TypeScript. Strong hands-on React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS; solid PostgreSQL/SQL and REST APIs; deploys and maintains apps on Vercel. Built AIDA, a production dental clinic SaaS requested by a practicing dentist—patients, odontograms, appointments, records, and payments—with role-based access so clinical data is limited to authorized physicians. Ships faster with responsible AI-assisted development (Cursor, Claude Code). Fluent in English (EF SET C2) and Spanish. Based in Managua, Nicaragua; remote-ready.

projects.name: AIDA
projects.description: Production HealthTech SaaS for dental clinics, requested by a practicing dentist. Built end-to-end: patients, odontograms, appointments, clinical records, and payments.
